result:
Round 77 passes verification with no bugs: `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true, at 1440x900 and 1280x720 in a fresh session with no login.

Ctrl+←/→ now stops at markers and at the start and end of clips on the selected tracks. The ◀ ▶ buttons still stop only at markers.

| Check | What happened |
|---|---|
| Only the active track (sfx) | Ctrl+→ went 3.450 → 5.450 → marker 6.300 → project end 101.702. The stems clip at 4.700 was skipped. Ctrl+← went back the same way to 0, then showed the "no more markers" message. |
| Two clips selected (sfx + stems) | Both clips' starts and ends became stops, in time order with the marker. |
| Time range on stems | Stems clip edges became stops. Dragging the range also selects that clip and makes stems the active track. After Ctrl+Shift+L, the music clip's start at 0.350 also became a stop. |
| ◀ ▶ buttons | 6.300, then the project end, and back. Clip edges were skipped. |
| Marker highlight | Stopping on a clip edge leaves the highlighted marker unchanged. Stopping on a marker highlights that marker. I checked this with two markers. |
| Real audio | Ctrl+→ landed on the sfx clip start; after Space the master meter reached 0.0 dB within 71 ms (1440) and 82 ms (1280). ▶ landed on 6.300; after Space it stayed silent for 1.3 s, as expected. |
| During playback | Ctrl+→ jumped to 3.458 and playback kept running. |
| Alt+→ on Linux | Moved the selected clip exactly like plain → (3.450 → 4.000) and did not move the playhead. |
| Focus in BPM box, volume or pan slider | Ctrl+→ did not move the playhead. With a marker focused it moved the playhead and left the marker in place. |
| Existing behaviour | Plain-arrow clip moves (Snap on and off), marker drag, right-click menu and "Play from here" all work as in round 76. |
| A's 9 test files | 202 of 202 pass. |
| Console | No hydration warnings and no unexpected errors. |
| Premium access | The demo page opens without login. `/studio/<id>` asks for sign-in. The token API returns 401 without login. |
| Source files | A's 8 files match A's reported hashes at start and end; the 453 frozen and 4 protected files are unchanged. |

A few rows of my first run failed because of my test script, not the app. My click hit the track-height handle at the bottom of the lane, and my status check picked up leftover text from an earlier action. I fixed both and reran everything. No tolerance was loosened, and the report says this.

**Not checked:**
- **Fake-token check (blocked):** a fake Bearer token returns 500 here because the backend isn't running in the cloud, so I couldn't confirm it gets 403.
- **Option+←/→ on a Mac:** this can't run on Linux Chromium. It is covered only by A's unit tests and the Tech Lead's real-Mac check (R77-T).
- **Full test suite, build and verify:** the root gate runs these; I didn't.

**For B to decide:**
- **Range wording vs. code:** the task text says that after Ctrl+Shift+L, clip edges "in the interval" become stops. The code makes every clip edge on every track a stop, even outside the range. That matches rule N2 and the Ableton manual text. If B meant only the interval, the rule needs changing; it isn't a defect in A's work.
- **A's open points, carried forward:**
  - A test now pins that Option+Shift+→ on a Mac still moves the selected clip; B never specified that.
  - The function names still say "marker" but now also return clip-edge stops.
  - The ◀ ▶ buttons still advertise Ctrl+arrow as their shortcut.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-77.md
- c-round-77.json
- c-round-77/ (raw results, screenshots, scripts, checkpoint)
